create_camera: create a Camera instance with position, orientation, and field of view to render images from a PyBullet simulation
create_calibrated_camera: create a CalibratedCamera with camera matrix, distortion coefficients, and world-to-camera transform for realistic rendering
load_camera_parameters: load camera calibration parameters from YAML files using CameraParameters.load to get intrinsic and extrinsic data
create_trifinger_camera_array: create a TriFinger camera array with three calibrated cameras from a config directory using create_trifinger_camera_array_from_config
convert_rgb_to_bayer: convert an RGB image to a BG Bayer pattern using rbg_to_bayer_bg to simulate raw camera sensor data
